annotations.rationale: Sigmoid for aux-loss must run in fp32; the buggy code feeds bf16 logits in. Root cause is dtype, not MoE topology (single-GPU reproduces, so parallel_dim=none per anti-example 6). Detected by hooking the op and checking input dtype == fp32 under precondition 'op == sigmoid_for_aux_loss', so pi_schema+pi_precond=true. Borderline P1 vs P4: chose P4 because op-level input dtype is not a default trace field, needs runtime hook.

INFERRED_FROM_SPARSE_CONFIG. TopKRouter missing calculate_per_token_loss attribute means aux loss not scaled by num_tokens. Detected at build by static assert on module attr; single-GPU MoE reproduces so parallel_dim=none (anti-example 6). Borderline numerical vs loss_computation: chose loss_computation because root cause is missing scaling logic, not float math.

After load_state_dict the outer ChainedOptimizer.param_groups must be identity-equal to concat of inner.param_groups. Detection requires reading module attrs (id() of param_groups list), not a numeric trace field, so P8 static assert with module_class==ChainedOptimizer precond. Borderline optimizer_state vs checkpoint: chose checkpoint per anti-example 7 (bug surfaces on load even though scope is optimizer).

When use_precision_aware_optimizer=True, get_grads_for_norm must read param.decoupled_grad never param.grad. Needs runtime hook on optimizer to inspect which grad source was selected, gated on config flag (precond). Borderline P7 vs P4: chose P4 because the check is on parameter dtype/source attribute at hook point, not a counter increment. parallel_dim=combo (FSDP+DP).

Aux loss tracker save called twice per step under activation checkpointing because guard checked self.training but not torch.is_grad_enabled(). Detection counts function calls per training step, gated on router module (precond). Borderline moe vs control_flow: chose control_flow because root cause is a missing condition guard, not MoE math. Single-GPU recompute reproduces, so parallel_dim=none (anti-example 6). P7 because counter check at hook point.

When topk==1 with post-softmax, softmax of length-1 vector is constant 1.0 with zero gradient. Detectable at build by asserting NOT(topk==1 AND use_pre_softmax==False) on TopKRouter (precond). Single-GPU MoE reproduces, so parallel_dim=none (anti-example 6). Borderline numerical vs moe: chose moe because the bug is specific to MoE router topk algorithm. P8 over P5 because static config check is cheaper than runtime grad-norm probe.

Coefficient passed to switch_load_balancing_loss_func must equal config.moe_aux_loss_coeff / tp_world_size; otherwise aux-loss grad inflates by tp_size after TP all-reduce. Topology-aware (depends on TP size) and precond-gated (only when MoE aux loss enabled). Borderline moe vs loss_computation: chose loss_computation because root cause is missing TP scaling, parallel to numerical loss-scaling bugs. P4 because check reads function arg at hook point.

HybridCPDataLoaderWrapper.pad_granularity=32 must be 128 when HybridEP is on, otherwise per-CP-rank shards land at offsets that misalign HybridEP dispatcher and silently mix tokens across ranks. Detection is a static config_invariant on a module attribute under precond hybrid_ep_enabled, so P8 + pi_precond. Borderline communication vs sharding: chose sharding because the fault is the per-rank shard offset, not the collective op.

WarmupCosineLR.get_lr() returns a scalar instead of a list of length num_param_groups. Single-rank reproduces, so parallel_dim=none. Checked by reading lr trace and asserting len(get_lr())==num_param_groups before optimizer.step. pi_schema+pi_precond (precond: scheduler is WarmupCosineLR). P1 (trace equality) over P5 because grad bounds are not involved.

TopKGate applies topk to raw logits instead of post-softmax gates. Detection_method=source_analysis indicates this is not directly runtime-observable from a single trace field; must be caught at build-time by asserting the routing implementation. Borderline numerical vs moe: chose moe because the bug is specific to MoE router algorithm, not generic numerical math. parallel_dim=none because single-GPU MoE reproduces (anti-example 6). pi_precond=true (precond is module_class==TopKGate); pattern P8 because runtime traces cannot easily distinguish topk-of-logits vs topk-of-softmax.

WarmupLR ignores optimizer.param_groups lr and uses hardcoded warmup_max_lr=0.001. After warmup, observed lr should equal optimizer-configured lr; reading trace lr value alone suffices, so pi_schema=true. Precond: scheduler is WarmupLR and step>=warmup_steps. Single-rank reproducible so parallel_dim=none. P1 (value equality on a trace field) not P5 because no grad-norm bound.

_save_moe_checkpoint short-returns on exp_dp_rank!=0, so only mp_rank_00_model_states.pt exists; non-zero TP ranks lose non-MoE weights. Invariant: one model_states.pt per TP rank, so checking requires TP topology (pi_topo) under precond MoE+TP>1 (pi_precond). Borderline moe vs checkpoint: chose checkpoint because the bug is missing save files, not router/expert behavior. P7 counts saved-file occurrences across ranks.

TopKGate.forward rebinds self.wg to a fresh fp32 Linear under ZeRO+fp16/bf16, orphaning the ZeRO-tracked parameter so its grads are never reduced or applied. Detection requires hooking TopKGate and checking wg.weight identity/data_ptr stays in ZeRO's tracked set across forwards under precond module_class==TopKGate AND ZeRO+mixed-precision (pi_precond). P7 (module-state counter/identity check) over P4 because the check is param-identity not dtype, and the orphan is in DP not EP routing path.

Constant key 'seq_parallel_comm_data_type' mismatches documented 'seq_parallel_communication_data_type', so user value is silently dropped at parse and dtype defaults to fp32. Detection compares user-set key vs parsed engine config at init. Borderline dtype vs control_flow: chose control_flow because the root cause is config-key wiring at init, not a numeric dtype computation. parallel_dim=none (single-rank parses config). P1 trace equality on parsed config field.

ZeRO3 omits frozen params from checkpoint; detected by comparing module.named_parameters() set vs saved keys at load (anti-example 7). Borderline P7 vs P8: chose P7 because the check fires only when an actual save/load runs (state-counter on saved-key set), not a pure build-time assertion. parallel_dim=DP because ZeRO3 shards along DP.

FP16_Optimizer skips TP-sliced grads as if replicated, undercounting global_grad_norm by sqrt(tp_size). Borderline gradient_sync vs communication: per anti-example 3, root cause is wrong reduction mask (which slices to sum), not group config, so gradient_sync. Detection compares TP=k norm to TP=1 reference, requires topology and only valid for TP-sliced params, so pi_topo+pi_precond=true.

MoE checkpoint stores dp_world_size instead of seq_dp_world_size, so resume reslices experts wrongly across SP ranks. Detected by post-load expert checksum vs pre-save fragment per rank (cross-rank equality with topology-aware mapping). check_stage=load per anti-example 7. Borderline checkpoint vs moe: chose checkpoint because the bug is in save/load metadata, not the MoE router algorithm itself.

Engine sets has_zero_optimizer_state = zero or bf16, so bf16 without ZeRO is wrongly flagged as having ZeRO state. Detected at build by asserting has_zero_optimizer_state == (zero_stage>0); a free-form module attribute, hence Tier 6. Borderline P8 vs P4: chose P8 because the wrong flag is set once in __init__ and never changes, single-GPU reproduces so parallel_dim=none.

restore_checkpoint forgot to reset global_step when restore_dataloader=False; LR scheduler then resumes mid-decay. Detected by trace assertion global_step==0 right after restore under that flag. Borderline P1 vs P7: chose P1 because step is a default trace field, not a runtime hook on module state. framework=olmo (allenai/OLMo per anti-example 8).

DeepSpeed scheduler set to WarmupLR not WarmupDecayLR, so LR plateaus after warmup instead of decaying. Detected from lr trace: post-warmup lr must be monotonically decreasing. Borderline P1 vs P8: chose P1 because both scheduler types are valid configs (build-time assert can't tell intent), the symptom only shows in the runtime lr sequence. framework=olmo (allenai/OLMo per anti-example 8).

EMA self-referential lerp: target arg equals the EMA itself, never the live grad_norm. Borderline numerical vs optimizer_state: chose optimizer_state because the corrupted state is the EMA buffer used for adaptive clipping (anti-example 9). Hooking lerp_ args is needed (P4), single-GPU reproduces so parallel_dim=none.

Under muP, ff_out (MuReadout) must be zero post-init but reset_parameters re-inits with normal. Borderline numerical vs other: chose numerical because the bug breaks muP's coordinate-check scaling property. Hook reads ff_out.weight after construction under precond use_mup=True (P4, pi_schema+pi_precond).

wte sized by vocab_size while ff_out sized by embedding_size; padding rows backprop to nothing. Borderline sharding vs numerical: not a parallel-shard bug, it's a model-init shape inconsistency observable statically on named_modules (P8). pi_precond=true (precond is module pair wte+ff_out present).

Leftover indices contiguously sliced per worker.id, so workers overlap and miss others. Borderline sharding vs data_loading: chose data_loading per table A (shard duplicate/missing). Detect by gathering worker-emitted sample ids and checking union==full set with no overlap (P3 cross-rank/worker, pi_topo+pi_precond). check_stage=other (data loader, not a model phase).

Per-param metric tensors live on CPU and get passed to dist.all_reduce, silently falling back to gloo with different reduction semantics. Borderline gradient_sync vs communication: chose communication because the root cause is wrong device/backend on the collective input, not the reduction op (anti-example 3). Hook before all_reduce, assert tensor.device.type=='cuda' (P6, pi_schema+pi_precond).

as_tensor truncates float soft_target_probs to int via astype(np.int_). Detected by hooking the dataloader op and asserting output_dtype matches input_dtype when input is float. Borderline dtype vs data_loading: chose data_loading because the failure surface is the dataset/collator path, not a model dtype mismatch. pi_precond=true (op==as_tensor on float array).

PoE branch sums detached output.z_loss into combined_loss, so regularizer has no gradient. Detected by hooking the loss aggregation and asserting every term has requires_grad=True. Borderline numerical vs loss_computation: chose loss_computation because the bug is in how loss terms are combined, not in numerical math. pi_precond=true (only when PoE+z_loss_multiplier active).

OLMoE3 recipe used CosWithWarmup where WSD was intended; both produce monotonic lr curves so runtime trace cannot distinguish them. Must be caught at build-time by asserting scheduler_class matches recipe intent. Borderline lr_schedule vs control_flow: chose lr_schedule because root cause is scheduler selection. pi_precond=true (precond is recipe==OLMoE3-WSD).

freeze_params=['teacher.*'] missed shared blocks.* params, so blocks trained against teacher gradients. Detected at build by walking named_parameters and asserting every param intended frozen has requires_grad=False under share_blocks=True. Borderline control_flow vs sharding: chose control_flow because the bug is about which params are frozen (a flag/pattern misconfig), not parameter splitting.

apply_activation_checkpointing hard-coded preserve_rng_state=False; with dropout active, backward recompute uses a different mask. Detected at build by asserting preserve_rng_state==True whenever any nn.Dropout exists in the model. Borderline numerical vs control_flow: chose control_flow because the bug is a misconfigured flag, not numerical math. pi_precond=true (precond is has_dropout=True).
